dct_description_sm: These data were collected as an investigation in the atmosphere-tundra interactions in the Canadian Arctic. The primary focus is on the magnitude and variability of ecosystem fluxes of carbon dioxide, water vapour and energy (radiation and sensible and ground heat flux). The relationship between these fluxes and meteorological controls, such as temperature and humidity, and solar radiation, is also an important objective of the study.
dct_title_s: Tundra Carbon, Water and Energy Fluxes, Daring Lake
